desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather: Outfit Tower!

Choose a door and build your outfit one step at a time 💖
Will you glow up… or get completely ruined?..

Every choice gives you new items:
💄 hair, outfits, accessories
💀 or something that will DESTROY your look

⚠️ WARNING: some doors WILL troll you ⚠️
But reach the end and prove you’ve got the best style 💅

💗 Like the game + join the group for extra perks

Do you have the drip… or are you gonna flop?
